# Process Contract Inventory (G00 working view)

<!-- Generated by docs/generate_process_contract_inventory.py from the IPHS certificates and the live functor inventory scan. Do not edit by hand. -->

This page is a derived view of existing metadata. The certificates in
`docs/source/theory/iphs_certificates/` and `test/audit/collect_functor_inventory.py`
remain the owners; the computation form and applicability columns are computed
by the auditable rules in the generator and add no second classification registry.
A process without a strict thermodynamic claim is complete when its own mature
contract (source, units, support, time, budget, tests) holds; missing IPHS
objects are not defects for it.

Main-process rows use the live inventory evidence for the exact main-certificate path.
A certificate is a constructor-scoped runtime point only when it declares the
certificate field `constructor_selection` (constructor keyword -> JSON scalar);
each process class keeps exactly one main certificate, which declares no selection.
Runtime-point certificates carry their own declared Level 4/5 claim and require an
executed governed witness from the named acceptance tests. Their presence does not
promote the main process level or inherit its runtime/state-advance evidence.
This metadata page does not ingest test-run results.

- Certificates: 94; live implemented processes: 88; fail-closed public entries: 4.
- Computation forms: algebraic constraint (index-1 descriptor DAE) = 1; algebraic diagnostic (read-only observation) = 15; algebraic field / forcing law = 4; conservative interface mapping (scale coupling) = 10; continuous stochastic process (SDE) = 1; empirical rate law = 25; field PDE = 1; history-dependent exchange (memory kernel) = 1; hybrid topology event detector = 2; managed boundary exchange (scheduled event / port) = 5; marked jump process (marked Poisson) = 1; moving-mesh conservative FVM (ALE) = 1; pool-transfer kinetics ODE = 3; spatial transport PDE (FVM/FDM/DEC discretization) = 8; storage-discharge / resistance transport ODE = 14; strict IPHS runtime point (claimed Level 4/5) = 2.
